column4: *To qualify for the EOL Finals: 1st Place in EOL Race - 6 spots in total / Remaining 2 spots will go to the highest ranked riders who are not qualified yet. If one or more rider(s) wins multiple spots throught Race and/or Underground wins, those spots will go to the next rider in the ranking. If one or more riders qualified can't go to the EOL Finals their place will go to a on the spot Wildcard! If enough riders sign up for the finals a 16 rider bracket can be made instead of a 8 rider only!
Special thanks to Patrick Lopez for helping create this ranking
